scheme_name: Cash Award to Top Ranking Holders in Public Examinations
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India.
Applicant must be a native of the Union Territory of Puducherry by birth or by continuous residence for at least five years.
Applicant must be studying in a Government or Private High School, Higher Secondary School, or in Intermediate (2nd Year) at a Government Junior College within Puducherry.
Applicant must be among the top three rank holders in the SSLC, SSC, Matriculation, HSC, or Intermediate (2nd Year) public examinations.
benefits_summary: Cash awards of ₹50,000, ₹30,000 and ₹20,000 for 1st, 2nd and 3rd rank holders in various public examinations.
